style.vernacular: Brick city with a stone plinth: narrow three-to-four-storey townhouses (maisons de maitre) in red-brown or yellow-grey brick or cream-painted stucco, with bluestone plinths and window sills, tall sash-like windows, bay windows and steep slate or tile roofs with dormers; Art Nouveau and Art Deco facades with ironwork and sgraffito; 19th-century Haussmann-style boulevards; post-war 'Brusselisation' office slabs in glass and concrete; and Flemish brick villages around the city with small neo-Gothic churches and moated castles.
